state.question: These numbered clips are shuffled segments from one cooking video. Determine their chronological order. Return only clip numbers joined by ->.
state.summary: Visual budget exhausted, so PLAN is forbidden. The best-supported chronology is v4 -> v3 -> v5 -> v1 -> v2: v4 shows grain cooking before v5 adds grain; v5's bowl contains red pieces likely corresponding to the tomatoes added in v3, so v3 precedes v5; v5's mixed-salad state precedes v1 pouring lemon over a salad bowl, and v1's olive-oil presentation precedes v2's seasoning/finished-salad close-up.
